title: Consent signed under pressure, reported by the beneficiary
description: A 'yes' is on record, but it was communicated by the acting party, obtained from a highly vulnerable person under a steep power asymmetry, through unclear, pressuring language.
intended_goal: Obtain consent to a new fee schedule.

consent_profile.notes: Consent was reported by the operator's staff, not by the resident.

expected_consequences: The resident is recorded as having agreed.

language_act.text: You have to sign now; there is no other option. Don't argue -- we know what's best for you.
